result.description:
All Industries Group is an innovative, multi-disciplined design, engineering and fabrication specialist. Focusing on product supply and turnkey solutions for local, national and international clients.

All Industries Group is a family owned and run manufacturing business on the central coast of Yeppoon, Qld, with its team built with the most experienced, skillful, and committed employees, is the largest manufacturing company in Livingstone Shire.

All Industries strives to set the standard of what quality looks like in the advanced manufacturing space, through our systems and culture. We are dedicated to ensuring the business is run with its employees in mind. This is accomplished through our core values which are at the centre of everything we do. These include Quality, Teamwork, Family, Integrity, and Education.

We are seeking experienced DRAFTSPERSON/ PLANNER to join our busy workshop on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
To carry out design and development of produce including design verification and validation.
Ensuring all work is carried out in accordance with All Industries Group policies and procedures
Calculate dimensions, weight limitations and requirements in materials
Describe production methods step-by-step (including equipment and software types to be used)
Create detailed designs with Inventor and AutoCAD software
Design diagrams, maps and layouts to illustrate workflow
Identify potential operational issues and redesign products to improve functionality
Ensure final designs comply with AS/NZ & ISO standards, regulations and quality standards
Create manuals that describe existing products’ operation, features and maintenance, eg. Dossiers, close our reports etc
Provide quotations and updates to customers when required
Creating and control of production orders following AIG’s procedures using ERP system (ITMS)
Daily update of Work In Progress (WIP), job schedule and communicate information with the rest of the production team (5 day production schedule minimum)
Liaise with the production supervisor to ensure jobs are meeting deadlines, within budget hours and are meeting Quality Assessment (QA)
Encourage and maintain acceptable QA and Key Performance Indicator (KPI)
Maintain accuracy and up to date data in AIG’s Electronic Resource Planner (ERP) System (ITMS) and server drives
Include information on project planning/management, estimation & profitability
Raise NCR’s, recommend corrective action, and offer suggestions for improvement
Participate in weekly production meetings and engineering meetings
Carry out design and development of products, including verification and validation of designs
To ensure all records, including drawing numbers etc are up to date
Develop defined scope of works for tenders and attend to site/jobs when required
To ensure all communication is engaged with internal, external and third-party contractors
To report to the Management System Manager (MSM)
Undertake training for professional development and coaching and be involved in AIG’s competitive business systems (Lean/Six Sigma)

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
At least with more than 4-years of experience in the same trade
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Working closely with clients and internal teams, you will deliver secure, scalable and high-quality software solutions while contributing to innovative digital products that create meaningful business outcomes.  What you'll be doing   Analysing user requirements and business specifications to determine software design and programming solutions.  Designing, developing, testing, implementing and maintaining enterprise software applications.  Writing, reviewing and maintaining efficient, reliable and well-documented program code.  Developing full-stack software applications using TypeScript, React and C# (.NET).  Designing and delivering cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions and event-driven architectures.  Developing, integrating and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services.  Modifying and enhancing existing software applications by implementing new functionality, resolving defects and improving performance.  Performing software testing, debugging, validation and troubleshooting to ensure software quality, reliability and security.  Preparing and maintaining software documentation, technical specifications and system design documentation.  Developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.  Participating in Agile software development activities including sprint planning, code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.  Collaborating directly with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical software solutions.  Applying AI-assisted software development tools to support software design, implementation, testing and delivery while maintaining quality, security and maintainability.   You'll thrive here if you...   Have at least four years' relevant experience as a Developer Programmer or in a closely related software development role.  Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.  Have strong programming skills using TypeScript, React and C# (.NET).  Have experience designing, developing and maintaining enterprise software applications.  Have experience building and deploying cloud-based applications using Microsoft Azure.  Have experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services.  Have experience using Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions and CI/CD practices.  Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.  Can analyse business requirements and translate them into effective software solutions.  Communicate clearly and work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary project teams.  Demonstrate sound judgement when using AI-assisted development tools to improve software delivery while maintaining quality and security. result.description:
Trussmaster is a leading supplier of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames, floor systems, laminated beams and timber preservative treatment. Our supply extends from the Sunshine Coast in QLD to the South Sydney region of NSW.

For over 40 years we have developed a reputation as a dependable and low-cost supplier to some of Australia’s best-known builders.

Our competitive advantage has been established by offering efficient design, process-based quality assurance and comprehensive site support to large-scale builders and timber wholesalers. Our continued investment in leading-edge software and equipment facilitates quick and accurate quoting as well as reliable production and delivery scheduling.

We are seeking highly experienced Detailer to join our team of dedicated professionals. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

Role Purpose
A Detailer’s purpose is to interpret house plans, customer specifications, and efficient on-site building practices to generate an accurate and timely job detail using PrydaBUILD (design) and MYOB EXO (job costing) software. A Detailer will follow a documented, standardised process and operate within specified timeframes. A Detailer will independently generate approximately 1 job detail per day for single or two-storey residential houses.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Managing
Respond to technical or work performance questions from colleagues

Customer orientation
Informs customers about solutions that meet their needs
Gain an understanding of needs and problems with specific customer groups
Can discuss basic install issues with builder representatives
Controlling progress
Work in a structured manner and in accordance with the standard process of generating a job detail
Independently manage time and workflow to ensure production targets are met

Attention to detail
Design job components with a clear understanding of practical on-site building practices
Follows instructions carefully and flawlessly
Job detailing/ estimating
Identify and solve impediments to completing work, such as unclear plans, missing information or inconsistencies between plans and customer specifications
Interpret customers’ plans and job quote file to accurately and systematically generate a Pryda BUILD design file and MYOB EXO job sheet
Designs complex 2 story residential homes
Provides feedback to peers
Checking colleagues detailing

Performance Goals:
Generate job design files with no errors of design and efficient design principles
Generate Job Sheets with clear separation of items to be either picked from stock or purchased
Generate clear and unambiguous layout documents for on-site construction
Identify and resolve unclear, inconsistent or ambiguous job information
Completes at least 1000 units of production per week
Work independently, diligently and accurately
Identify alternate options that could help save costs when detail checking.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Front End Developer (also known as Front End Engineer, Web Developer, Front End Software Developer, Software Developer, CSS Developer, HTML Developer, Programmer, Software Engineer)
The purpose of the Front End Developer is to be a hands-on developer working in a cross discipline team to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Collaborating with other engineers (front-end & back-end), creatives, and clients, the front-end developer may implement web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 4+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
?	Proficiency in reactive front-end experiences using ReactJS and/or VueJS.
?	Experience building canvas applications.
?	Working knowledge of application performance parameters as well as the ability to assess and optimize them.
?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary: $85K – 105K package

Senior Front End Developer
We are on the hunt for a Senior Front End Developer to be a hands-on developer working with cross discipline teams to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Leading a team of engineers (front-end & back-end) while working closely with other creative teams and clients, the Senior Front-End Developer is responsible for building & maintaining various features as per clients’ requirements. This may include the implementation of web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 6+ years.
?	Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.

?	Experience building canvas applications.

?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary – Over threshold


Back End Developer (also known as Web Developer, Software Engineer, Programmer, Software Developer, Back-End Software engineer)
The Back End Developer is an analytical, goal-oriented person who will work with team members to troubleshoot and improve existing back-end applications and processes. Using their understanding of programming languages and tools, the Back End Developer will analyze current codes and industry developments, formulate more efficient processes & solve problems, to create a more seamless experience for users. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication, computer, and project management skills.
The role will involve: compiling and analysing data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement, collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and enable the design to be more functional, implementing cohesive codes where necessary to enhance the user experience. The back end developer will also be responsible for developing ideas for new programs, features or products via research & monitoring of industry trends.
To succeed as a backend developer, you should be focused on building a better, more efficient program and creating a better end-user experience. You should be knowledgeable, collaborative, and motivated. The ideal candidate will have relevant tertiary qualification in computer programming, computer science or a related field; or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification, but also ideally have a minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role. Fluency or understanding of specific languages, such as Java, PHP, or Python, and operating systems may be required. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools; be focused on efficiency, user experience, and process improvement and also have excellent project and time management skills.
Salary – Over threshold
